In this episode I walk through how I pull off-market leads in minutes using a simple data scraping and texting workflow. I demo it live with RV parks, but this system works just as well for storage units, restaurants, medspas, and contractors. I scrape Google Maps with Outscraper, clean and validate the numbers, then send high-reply texts with Sinch MessageMedia — even jumping on a live call with an owner. If you want a fast, repeatable way to uncover real deals in any niche, this walkthrough is for you.

Enjoy!
